Reported by the Companion Animal Travel Desk after the cabin team and gate staff raised an urgent concern on the inbound Aurelia Skyways flight.

Incident Report: Companion Animal Cabin Heat Complaint

During boarding, a traveler reported that a companion animal in the cabin was already restless and breathing hard. The seat area around the carrier felt warmer than normal, and the traveler asked for help before pushback. The cabin team checked the carrier placement, confirmed there was no blocked airflow from bags, and moved the carrier to a better spot with more room on the floor. The senior coordinator also asked for a quick cabin check near the row and spoke with the traveler in calm terms to keep the situation from getting worse.

The traveler said the animal, Luna, had been uneasy since the gate area and seemed affected by the warmer cabin conditions. A note was made for the record because the concern was raised right away and the traveler wanted the issue documented. <<FACT F113>> The traveler was told the matter would be logged and reviewed through the normal service channel, and the cabin team stayed alert for any change in the animal's breathing or behavior. No further distress was seen after the adjustment, and the animal settled down once the carrier was repositioned and the nearby airflow improved.

Later, the traveler asked about filing a claim related to the cabin overheating concern. The desk staff explained the general claim process in plain words and noted the complaint in the service file so the follow-up team could review it. <<FACT F117>> The records aide also passed the report to the operations contact for inspection of the cabin cooling note and to make sure crew guidance stayed clear for future companion animal trips.

The follow-up action is to keep the file open until the review is done and to contact the traveler if more details are needed. Companion Animal Travel Desk
